name: ecd-spectra
description: Precise, auditable extraction and standardization of experimental ECD spectra from scientific literature.

interface.shortDescription: Recover validated numerical ECD spectra from literature.
interface.longDescription: An auditable workflow for locating ECD figures, extracting vector or raster curves, preserving signs and units, standardizing numerical data, and reviewing overlays before comparison with computed spectra.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $extract-ecd-spectra to extract this published ECD spectrum into a validated numerical package.
